title: Unpaired electrons and magnetism
caption: Each unpaired electron adds to the magnetic moment: the spin-only value is μ = √(n(n + 2)) μB. High-spin Mn²⁺ (d⁵) has five, μ = 5.92; Cu²⁺ (d⁹) has one, 1.73; Zn²⁺ (d¹⁰) none, so it is diamagnetic.
alt: Three splitting diagrams: Mn²⁺ with five unpaired electrons, Cu²⁺ with one, Zn²⁺ with none.
description: Mn²⁺ d⁵ high spin: one electron in each d orbital, μ = 5.92 μB.
